integrity: Mathematical argument and independently implemented finite checks are included. Priority and correctness assessments have not been independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Exact weight polynomial for labeled rook graphs only; an exponential binary-support sum; numerical minimum is prior-implied by perfect Roman rook minimization; unindexed equivalent results and priority uncertainty remain; finite tests do not prove infinite statements.
title: Binary-support enumeration of total perfect Roman labelings on rook graphs
